The door is opening again. Once it reaches a wide angle, I’ll withdraw sideways from the handle and lower the hand below the door before returning to the squash.

Lowering the hand straight down has cleared the door without closing it. I’ll pick up the squash again and approach the cavity from the right side.
The squash is held again, and the door has stayed open. I’m raising it to the cavity, then I’ll place it inside, release it, and pull the hand clear before closing the door.
The squash slipped during the carry and landed on the stove. I’ll recover it there with a deeper grasp and keep the fingers oriented downward during the transfer.
The recovered grasp is wider and stayed stable during the lift. The squash is also closer to the microwave now, so the remaining carry is shorter.
The squash has reached the microwave interior, and the grasp is still holding. I’ll lower it to the tray, open the fingers, and withdraw the hand.
The squash has been released inside and the hand is clear of it. I’m moving below the door to approach its outer face, then I’ll push it fully closed and press Start.
The squash is visibly resting on the microwave tray. The hand is catching under the open door, so I’m moving the base sideways to give it clearance before closing.
